description.0: A greatsword decorated in gold. Legend has it that it was the favored weapon of a certain exalted Harmost back in the distant past.

0.0: Every 10s, the equipping character plays a "Harmonic Movement" of the corresponding type for a boost in the following order: <cryo>+18%</cryo> ATK > <cryo>+120</cryo> Elemental Mastery > <cryo>+28%</cryo> Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Each instance of Harmonic Movement lasts 10s. This effect can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.
0.1: Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction will also grant an additional 12-second instance of "Harmonic Movement: Contrapuntal" with the same effects as the Harmonic Movement active when Stellar Glimmer is triggered. This effect stacks with the original Harmonic Movement effect, and can trigger once every 12s.
